source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Rebecca, thank you for the quick reply, and for your interest in the project!

Regarding your question, it would be better if we receive them in separate files, also MP3 formate would be fine & enough.

Thank you again and looking forward to receiving & hearing the tracks!

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you Rebecca,
2nd & 3rd takes are actually two different directions, but they are really good!

Can you send both edited separately so I can send them to top managers for approval?

And i’ll proceed with the 1st payment today, but for the remaining amount, can we wait till Sunday to have the final approval for the final take?
